India Designates 23 Pakistan-Based Individuals as Terrorists Under UAPA

The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) has designated 23 individuals based in Pakistan as terrorists under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA). The list includes 17 Pakistanis and six Indian nationals. This move comes amid heightened tensions between India and Pakistan, with several terrorist groups operating across the border.
